product.name: Flo Recruit Applicant Tracking
product.description: An applicant tracking system designed for the legal industry, facilitating the hiring process.

product.name: Virtual Events
product.description: A platform feature allowing the creation and management of virtual events, including webinars and virtual chats.

product.name: OCI Access Plan
product.description: A service offering limited-time access to features such as live interview dashboards, synced schedules, and bulk transcripts for OCI events.

product.name: Virtual Chats
product.description: A scheduling tool for setting up personal or small-group virtual meetings, with automated email confirmations and live schedule updates.

product.name: Webinar
product.description: A tool for hosting large virtual information sessions or training, with features for custom registration questions and automated email communications.

product.name: Live Monitoring Dashboard
product.description: A dashboard providing real-time visibility into virtual interview rooms and participant engagement.
